name: What can go wrong with a simple handyman repair?

mainEntity.name: What can go wrong with a simple handyman repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: The main risks are hidden damage, mismatched materials, and repairs that look simple but reveal a larger issue once opened up. In older Denver-area homes, that can mean settled framing, layered finishes, or prior patchwork that makes a basic fix more involved.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hidden damage, material mismatches, and older-home quirks can turn a simple repair into a larger job.
